quote: OTEZLA/OTEZLA XR is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with oral ulcers associated with Behçet's Disease.
limitations: Adult oral-ulcer indication; does not establish protection against ocular, vascular, intestinal or CNS disease.

quote: Apremilast is an oral small molecule inhibitor of phosphodiesterase 4 (PDE4)
limitations: Target engagement is distinct from organ-specific efficacy.

quote: apremilast resulted in a greater reduction in the number of oral ulcers than placebo
limitations: No inference of vascular/CNS protection; diarrhea, nausea and headache were reported.

quote: Infliximab neutralizes the biological activity of TNFα
limitations: Mechanism does not itself establish Behçet clinical benefit; no Behçet indication in inspected US label.

quote: Complete response was achieved by 22 out of 27 (81%) and 14 out of 25 (56%) patients
limitations: Small mixed vascular/CNS trial; no separate powered organ estimates, no global cure or long-term prevention claim. Serious adverse events: 15% versus 12%.
